about_the_game:
Experience a Glimpse into Sinfeld's Origins.

Step into the eerie world of Sinfeld: Evil Resident, where nothing is as it seems. You awaken in your New York apartment after Halloween, surrounded by remnants of last night's festivities. But something feels wrong. Locked doors, shifting shadows, and strange whispers suggest that the nightmare is just beginning.

In Sinfeld: Evil Resident, players will:

  • Explore the Apartment: Navigate through your apartment and uncover the unsettling mystery lurking within. Each room holds pieces of your lost memories, and secrets waiting to be revealed.

  • Unravel the Mystery: Investigate eerie surroundings and piece together fragments of the previous night. Engage with puzzles, interact with objects, and discover clues that pull you deeper into the unsettling atmosphere.

  • Solve Adaptive Puzzles: Face environmental puzzles that adapt to your progress, challenging you to think critically to uncover the truth.

  • Immerse in a Haunting Atmosphere: Experience an intense, atmospheric journey that combines open exploration with a deep narrative focused on psychological tension.

  • Feel the Unsettling Reality: With advanced physics and a haunting soundtrack, the demo offers a small slice of the Sinfeld experience, filled with chilling moments and dark revelations.

This demo offers a unique taste of the Sinfeld world—explore, solve, and survive to discover if you really want to know what happened last night. Remember, this is just the beginning.

Note: This is the demo version of Sinfeld: Evil Resident. Full game content and additional features will be available upon the complete release of Sinfeld: Evil Resident.

Help Us Shape the Final Game

Sinfeld: Evil Resident is still a work in progress, and we invite you to be part of our journey. Your feedback and support are essential in helping us refine and improve the gameplay experience as we continue developing Sinfeld. Join us in testing, exploring, and providing insights to help make the final release as terrifying and immersive as possible.

Add to Wishlist now to support the development of Sinfeld: Evil Resident and help us create our passion project!

Features

  • Deep Narrative

  • Open Exploration

  • Nightmarish Atmosphere

  • Adaptive Puzzles

  • Thought-Provoking Story

  • Haunting Soundtrack

  • Advanced Physics

  • New Revelations

Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K (or AMD Ryzen 7 3700X)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 2060 / AMD RX 5700 XT

short_description: Welcome to the demo of Sinfeld: Evil Resident, a bizarre first-person horror-comedy. Take the role of a struggling comedian experiencing the worst day of his life, now trapped in a surreal nightmare filled with chaotic madness and twisted humor.
